faqs.q: Can it follow up abandoned checkouts?
faqs.a: Yes. “Abandoned Checkout” starts the work when a customer leaves checkout. An AI agent can draft the follow-up, and it waits for your approval before it goes out.

faqs.q: Can it log each line item, not just the order?
faqs.a: Say so in the ask: one row per item. Captain plans the automation that way, and Google Sheets’ “Add Multiple Rows” writes several rows in one step. Check the plan before you approve it.

faqs.q: Can it cancel or refund orders?
faqs.a: The catalog has “Cancel Order”, which can refund through the original payment or store credit and restock items. Anything that moves money asks you first in 50agents.

faqs.q: How is this different from Shopify’s Sidekick?
faqs.a: Sidekick is Shopify’s AI assistant in every plan; it works with your store data and takes actions in your Shopify admin. 50agents starts from a Shopify event and acts in the other apps you run the business on, such as Google Sheets, Gmail or Slack. For changes inside the store itself, Sidekick is already in your admin.
